reasoning_content:
Web and Payload API work; DB connected; globals platform-settings exists with city Detmold (seeded global). The portal renders full HTML. Hocuspocus ready. Mailpit available. All required services up and healthy.

Let me do a couple more checks: admin returns 200, first-user registration page, and test that the board/realtime endpoint responds to a WebSocket upgrade perhaps. Also verify the healthcheck and that the /api/health returns ok. That's enough.

Let me check whether containers have restart policy and one more: verify NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL baked. Let me grep the built client bundle. Actually earlier grep of src file not needed. Let me test the WebSocket handshake to hocuspocus quickly using python? Not necessary.

Let me confirm the admin login page actually loads Payload UI (200 already). And test /api/health from inside.

One consideration: the guide says compose fails fast on missing vars; the .env sets both secrets. Good.

Let me verify the override is the only deviation and that it's documented. It's a sandbox-only adjustment. Does it invalidate installation completeness? The guide's base compose includes memory limits; the override removes them due to sandbox cgroup limitation. This is an environmental adaptation, not a functional deficiency. The stack runs.

Let me also double check that the hocuspocus container can reach web for auth (PAYLOAD_INTERNAL_URL). Env is set to http://web:3000 default. Let me check hocuspocus env and test connectivity.

action.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== hocuspocus env ===" && docker compose exec -T hocuspocus printenv 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'PORT|PAYLOAD_INTERNAL_URL|HOCUSPOCUS' | sed -E 's/(SECRET=).*/\1***/'; echo "=== hocuspocus -> web connectivity ===" && docker compose exec -T hocuspocus sh -c 'wget -q -O - http://web:3000/api/health 2>&1 || echo "wget failed"' ; echo; echo "=== register page ===" && curl -sSL -m 30 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} final=%{url_effective}\n" -H "Host: app.urbankit.de" http://localhost:3020/de/register

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && echo \"=== hocuspocus env ===\" && docker compose exec -T hocuspocus printenv 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'PORT|PAYLOAD_INTERNAL_URL|HOCUSPOCUS' | sed -E 's/(SECRET=).*/\\1***/'; echo \"=== hocuspocus -> web connectivity ===\" && docker compose exec -T hocuspocus sh -c 'wget -q -O - http://web:3000/api/health 2>&1 || echo \"wget failed\"' ; echo; echo \"=== register page ===\" && curl -sSL -m 30 -o /dev/null -w \"HTTP %{http_code} final=%{url_effective}\\n\" -H \"Host: app.urbankit.de\" http://localhost:3020/de/register", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Test hocuspocus connectivity to web"}
